jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Support Platform & AI
jobs.description: About Jimdo We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses. Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. Role Overview At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs. We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us. You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it. The team and who you'll work with You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation. You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools. You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors. What you'll be doing: Set the vision for our support platform and AI with the Head of CSS, and turn it into a roadmap, a business case and results. Lead, coach and grow your team, and bring specialists and engineers together around one backlog and clear quarterly outcomes. Own how well our chatbot, Zendesk AI agents and Copilot perform: define what a good AI answer is, measure it, and switch off what doesn't help customers. Improve routing, user identification and self-service entry points so customers get to the right answer faster. Spend real time with customers and support agents: read tickets, listen to chats, see where people get stuck. Build a written case for every bigger piece of work, own the cost to serve, and check results against your forecast. Turn what you learn in support into evidence that helps product teams fix problems at the source. Your first months After 3 months: your team works from one backlog and one outcome roadmap, and the quality bar for AI answers is agreed. After 6 months: you've delivered and reported your first quarterly outcome, including how AI resolution compares with your forecast. What you bring to the table 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally including support, CX, service or internal platform products. You've shipped AI or chatbot features in production and can name the metric you moved, the baseline and the result. You explain product decisions in commercial terms: cost, savings, effect, and what you learned when a forecast was wrong. You've managed people and led people who didn't report to you, ideally across departments. You do your own analysis with SQL or BI tools, and design and read experiments without waiting for an analyst. A clear point of view on what a good support experience is, and fluent English for everyday work. Nice to have Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar tool such as Intercom or Salesforce Service Cloud), including AI agents, routing and automations. Experience using support insights to change a product team's roadmap. German language skills. What we offer: Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve. Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity. Continuous Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression. Competitive Benefits Package: Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly. A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace. An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling. Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever. Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity. By sending your application, you declare that you read and understand the Jimdo Applicant Privacy Policy Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. About the Role We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Platform team. Platform powers every customer journey at Zego: the core services behind quoting, buying, paying for, changing, renewing and cancelling a policy. You’ll own a product domain within Platform, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping refine the longer-term platform strategy as we rebuild and modernise some of Zego’s most critical services. You’ll turn technical challenges into business value, and make sure your services are resilient, compliant and ready to be used by AI agents as well as our apps. What You’ll Be Doing Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals , and help refine the longer-term plans for Platform, balancing new capability, legacy rebuilds and reliability. Lead complex discovery autonomously as we modernise the policy lifecycle, moving capability off legacy systems one safe slice at a time. Dive deep into technical detail , understanding dependencies and failure modes, and making informed trade-offs with engineering. Treat internal teams as your customers , so launching a new product, price or journey on the platform is fast and predictable. Make your services AI-ready , with clean, well-documented APIs and data that agents and automations can use safely, and establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain. Put the right metrics in place , from reliability and incidents to time-to-launch and cost to serve, and build the business case for platform investment. Build compliance in from day one with Legal, Compliance and Finance, so money flows and customer communications are accurate and auditable. Bring stakeholders along , running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate. What You’ll Need to Be Successful Platform product ownership. A track record of owning a technical, platform or backend product domain and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment. Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on system architecture, APIs, event-driven services and workflow orchestration. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science. Legacy modernisation. You’ve led incremental rebuilds of business-critical services while keeping the lights on. Data and commercial fluency. You use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground decisions, query Snowflake or Looker yourself, and can build the case for platform investment. Clarity in complexity. You untangle dependencies across multiple business domains and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Regulated environment. Ideally, experience in insurance, payments, lending or financial services, with compliance built into product design. You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like . Benefits 🎁 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year. 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution. 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build 🩺 Private medical insurance. 🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. 💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance. Equal opportunities 🌈 We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Retail
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward. We're looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us define and build purpose-built, highly differentiated shopping experiences across our growing portfolio of Retail categories. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the Retail Categories team. Retail only wins category by category; a single, generic shopping experience cannot do justice to the unique ways people buy apparel, auto parts, or home improvement goods. This role owns the end-to-end category shopping experience for a defined portfolio, transforming broad customer promises into shipped surfaces and distinct emotional hooks that drive habitual buying behavior. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Define Category Strategy: Formulate the category experience strategy and decide which categories and bets to invest in first, sequencing for maximum growth and impact. Execute Signature Product Bets: Translate each category's promise into concrete, testable product bets—such as personal-shopper features using doorstep returns for Apparel or fitment-accurate part lookup for Auto Parts—and ship them end to end. Optimise Category Surfaces: Own the category merchandising and storefront surfaces that differentiate one vertical from another while maintaining a cohesive and intuitive Retail experience. Leverage Platform Capabilities: Partner with shared platform infrastructure (such as doorstep returns or fulfillment) to build bespoke category experiences without rebuilding core infrastructure. Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with BD, Sales, Catalog, and Search teams to ensure category surfaces are powered by accurate data and align cleanly with merchant relationships. Measure Impact: Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and directly move the needle on conversion and repeat purchases. What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Proven Consumer Product Experience: Demonstrated success in product management on consumer-facing products, ideally within e-commerce, marketplaces, or multi-sided platforms. Track Record of 0-to-1 Innovation: Proven ability to ship brand-new or highly differentiated shopping experiences, navigating ambiguity to break broad opportunities into focused, testable bets. Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact. Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy. Customer-Obsessed Product Instinct: A natural intuition for customer behaviour, understanding what makes a shopping experience feel right and how to design the emotional hook that drives retention. Nice to Have Specialised Retail Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with merchandising, category management, product detail pages (PDP), or specialised shopping flows. jobs.title: Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais)
jobs.description: Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais) Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Niveau : Senior Product Manager Équipe : Device Data Management (DDM) Contrat : CDI À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais . À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne. Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen. Ce que vous ferez : Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran. Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France. Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents. Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats. Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie. Ce que vous apportez : Critères essentiels : Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité technique et de marché à des interlocuteurs variés, clients compris, ainsi qu’une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (ingénierie, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery, etc.) pour livrer des solutions localisées Idéalement, vous avez : Une expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie en France : vous connaissez le fonctionnement du marché et ses acteurs clés (ex. Enedis / GRDF), notamment sur les données d’équipements et les flux de marché Une expérience avec des plateformes de gestion de l’énergie ou de services publics (utilities) sur le marché français Une bonne maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle. Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets. Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole. Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego. Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue. Nos avantages Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage) Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 € Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break) Venez comme vous êtes Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre page carrières et sur LinkedIn . jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Team
jobs.description: About us Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland. About the role As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service. What you’ll do: Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product. Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions. Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day. Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly. Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call. Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on. What you'll need: 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches. You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams. Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits. A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products. You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes. This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Generous start-up equity Competitive Salary Lunch provided in the office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How We Use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description: The role   We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale. This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time. The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time. You’re welcome to  work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel. Your responsibilities will include:   Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback. Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria. Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions. Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions. Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality. Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions. Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria. We expect you to have:   5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure. Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration. Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus. Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs. Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread. Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders. It will be an added bonus if you have:   Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains. Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions. Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments. People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs). Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
